reason: No box stand-in: a server render has no layout box, so the drawing is composed in the 2048-unit token box, as the canvas's fixed bitmap was, and the first layout/upgrade rewrites the geometry to the measured width. Only the drawing's pixels may differ; layout must remain unchanged.
Canvas bitmap opt-out: the server has no drawing context. The styled canvas box is preserved; upgrade paints its pixels. Layout must remain unchanged.
Inline SSR CSS versus adopted CSS rounds a few chip-border antialiasing channels by one level in Chromium (33 pixels locally). No geometry or larger color differences are allowed.
WebKit rasterizes the parsed SVG dropdown arrow differently from the reconstructed SVG (30 pixels, maximum channel delta 47 locally). Only that SVG region is excepted.
An engine without CSS anchors measures the indicator on upgrade. Only the indicator pixels may differ; its measured width must be nonzero and host layout must stay unchanged.
